race.comment: SWAN DANCE (6) looks the one to beat after resuming with a Murray Bdge Mdn win, scoring by just under two lengths from NUNYA and doing it with something in hand. Her career profile is very solid, with one win and five places from six starts, and she has already placed at this distance and at this track, so the rise to Class 1 company looks within reach. NUNYA (3) is the obvious danger after a dominant Mdn win at this track, where he beat IN PRIVATE by seven and a half lengths as a very short odds-on favourite. The new 2121m trip is the query, but his consistency and local win keep him right in the race. LADY DEEDS (11) was beaten only a neck at Strathalbyn after being held up near the 400m, and third-up with first-time blinkers she has the right profile to improve again. LARGS LEGACY (5) was safely held in Saturday company last start, but her Balaklava Mdn win two back, barrier 1 and the 3kg claim give her a genuine chance to bounce back if she handles 2121m at the first attempt.
